integrity: Definitions, component bijections, and exact domain boundaries are stated explicitly; independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Valid for labeled rook graphs with both dimensions at least two; not a classification for arbitrary graph products.
The source tables of minimal total dominating set totals are prior; the new claim is the graded polynomial, component theorem, and upper-size gap.
Finite code experiments corroborate but do not replace the general proof.
Implicit refinements of a published recurrence and additional equivalent treatments are remaining priority risks.
title: Minimal total domination of rook graphs: a component census and a forbidden near-maximum size
